samples.label: Fysisk hälsa, sjukdomar och övriga besvär efter ekonomi, kön och år by Diseases and other health problems, Percentage and confidence interval, Financial situation, Age, Sex and Year
samples.source: The Public Health Agency of Sweden, the national public health survey
note: As of 2024, all the statistics are included in Sweden's official statistics (SOS). In 2022 only some of the statistics were included as official statistics. Statistics for the years before 2022 were produced according to similar standards but do not have a declaration of quality. Read more about this in the quality declaration (in Swedish).'Kvalitetsdeklaration'

The results presented are based on questions asked in the national public health survey: Do you have any of the following symptoms? Diabetes? Asthma? Allergies? High blood pressure? Do you have any of the following problems and symptoms? Eczema or skin rash? Headaches or migraines? Incontinence (leaking urine)? Ringing in your ears (tinnitus)? Recurring stomach or bowel problems? Dizziness?
The national public health survey is a sample survey of the country's population aged 16 and older. The population aged 16 to 84 are covered before 2021.
